source.title: The Beast Master of Moonglade
source.description:
While I'm tracking Van Amburgh, you could visit an old associate of mine. Banteazo is in Moonglade, where she studies animal behavior with the druids in order to refine training for companions. She's also fought Van Amburgh before and might have some pointers. Say hello to her for me!

Once you finish, we'll meet up again in Winterspring, where I plan to follow up some leads. I have an old camp in the northern hills where we can talk privately.
source.objective: Travel to the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade, on Kalimdor. Seek out the troll Banteazo, a hunter, and ask her for insight into beast mastery.
source.completion: You say dat Estelenn says hello? Odd, I've not seen dat Alliance flitterbug since da last time we traded arrows in Stranglethorn Vale... well, regardless, dis place is neutral ground. If she sent you to me, den you be here to talk about animals, yah?
